alert.rule_name: Directory Replication Rights Exercised by Non-DC Principal
alert.description: A security principal that is not a domain controller invoked the directory replication service (DRSUAPI DsGetNCChanges) against the domain naming context. Replication rights allow an account to request the password hash of any principal in the domain, including krbtgt, without ever touching a domain controller's disk or memory.
alert.detection_logic: Security EventID=4662 WHERE ObjectType = '{19195a5b-6da0-11d0-afd3-00c04fd930c9}' (domainDNS) AND Properties CONTAINS ANY ('{1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2}' /* DS-Replication-Get-Changes */, '{1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2}' /* DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All */) AND SubjectUserName NOT IN (domain_controller_computer_accounts) AND SubjectUserName NOT IN (approved_replication_service_accounts)

replication_guids.{1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2}: DS-Replication-Get-Changes — the extended right permitting a principal to request replicated directory data.
replication_guids.{1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2}: DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All — extends the above to secret attributes, i.e. password hashes (unicodePwd, ntPwdHistory, supplementalCredentials).
replication_guids.{19195a5b-6da0-11d0-afd3-00c04fd930c9}: ObjectType domainDNS — the domain naming context itself, the root object replication is requested against.

access_mask_decode.0x100: ACTRL_DS_CONTROL_ACCESS — exercise of an extended right, not a normal read or write.

enrichment.principal_role: CORP\j.marsh is an interactive domain user account. It is not a domain controller computer account and not a directory-synchronisation service account. In a healthy domain, the only principals invoking DsGetNCChanges are DC computer accounts replicating with each other, and any explicitly delegated sync accounts (for example Azure AD Connect).
enrichment.network_path: The two connections from WKS-4471 to 10.24.8.10 immediately precede the alert: TCP/135 is the RPC endpoint mapper, and TCP/49674 is the dynamically-assigned port the endpoint mapper hands back for the drsuapi interface. This is the wire footprint of a remote DRSUAPI bind.
enrichment.source_binary: The connections originate from C:\Users\j.marsh\Desktop\svcupdate.exe — an unsigned executable running from a user desktop directory, not from a system or program-files path.
enrichment.logon_correlation: Security/4624 logon ID 0x824909 (network logon, Kerberos, from 10.24.8.21) is the same logon ID recorded on all three 4662 records, tying the replication request back to the WKS-4471 session.
enrichment.blast_radius: A successful replication of the domain naming context should be treated as full domain credential compromise, including the krbtgt account. krbtgt compromise enables forged Kerberos ticket-granting tickets, which survive password resets of individual users.
